paragraphs.title: Completion of the Temple and the Bringing of the Ark

easy.explanation: The verse says, “Thus all the work that Solomon made for the house of the LORD was finished.”
easy.q: What was finished according to the beginning of the passage?

answers: David’s dedicated things, silver, gold, and instruments
easy.explanation: Solomon brought in all the things David had dedicated, along with the silver, gold, and instruments.
easy.q: What did Solomon bring into the treasures of the house of God?

easy.explanation: The passage says, “the Levites took up the ark.”

answers: To bring up the ark of the covenant to Jerusalem
medium.explanation: They gathered to bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the city of David, which is Zion.
medium.q: Why did Solomon assemble the elders, tribal heads, and chief fathers?

answers: In the oracle, in the most holy place, beneath the cherubim
Among the treasures of the house of God
medium.explanation: The priests brought the ark into the oracle of the house, into the most holy place, under the cherubim.
medium.q: Where was the ark placed in the Temple?

medium.explanation: The verse identifies the oracle as “the most holy place,” where the ark was placed.
medium.q: What does “the oracle of the house” refer to in this passage?

answers: All the vessels of the tabernacle
challenge.explanation: The passage says, “There was nothing in the ark save the two tables.”
challenge.q: What was inside the ark when it was placed in the Temple?

answers: The ark was outside the Temple
The ark was placed inside the most holy place
challenge.explanation: The staves could be seen from the oracle but not without, showing that the ark was inside the inner holy place.
challenge.q: What can be inferred from the fact that the ends of the staves were seen from the oracle but not outside?

answers: That only a few animals were offered
That only the Levites made sacrifices
That so many sheep and oxen were offered they could not be counted
challenge.explanation: The sacrifices “could not be told nor numbered for multitude.”
challenge.q: What does the large number of sacrifices emphasize?

paragraphs.title: The Priests and Levites in Sacred Service

answers: They served together without waiting by course
They carried the vessels outside the city
easy.explanation: The priests who were present were sanctified and did not wait by course.
easy.q: What was true of the priests who were present and sanctified?

easy.explanation: The Levites were “arrayed in white linen.”
easy.q: What were the Levite singers wearing?

easy.explanation: The verse lists cymbals, psalteries, and harps.
easy.q: Which instruments did the Levites have?

answers: At the east end of the altar
medium.explanation: The Levites stood “at the east end of the altar.”
medium.q: Where did the Levite singers stand?

medium.explanation: The passage mentions “an hundred and twenty priests sounding with trumpets.”
medium.q: Who accompanied the Levites by sounding trumpets?

medium.explanation: The phrase describes what the Levite singers wore.
medium.q: What does the phrase “white linen” describe?

answers: They were divided into many rotations
They served together without their usual divisions
challenge.explanation: The text says the priests did not then wait by course, indicating that they served together.
challenge.q: What does the priests’ serving together without waiting by course indicate?

answers: The Levites played instruments and the priests sounded trumpets
The priests played instruments and the Levites offered cattle
Both groups only carried the ark
challenge.explanation: The Levites were singers and musicians, while the priests sounded the trumpets.
challenge.q: How were the duties of the Levites and priests connected?

answers: The Levites stood east of the altar, and the priests sounded trumpets with them
The Levites stood in the most holy place, and the priests stood outside
The Levites stood among the treasures, and the priests stood by the ark
challenge.explanation: The Levites stood at the east end of the altar, while the priests with them sounded trumpets.
challenge.q: What distinction does the passage make between the Levites and the priests with trumpets?

paragraphs.title: The Song of Praise and the Appearance of the Cloud

answers: They made one sound in praise and thanksgiving
easy.explanation: They were as one, making one sound in praising and thanking the LORD.
easy.q: What did the trumpeters and singers do together?

answers: He is king of Israel only
He is good and His mercy endures forever
easy.explanation: They praised the LORD, saying, “For he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.”
easy.q: What did they say about the LORD?

easy.explanation: The passage says, “the house was filled with a cloud.”
easy.q: What filled the house of the LORD?

answers: The priests could not stand to minister
medium.explanation: The priests could not stand to minister because of the cloud.
medium.q: What happened because the house was filled with the cloud?

answers: The praise came before the house was filled with the cloud
The cloud disappeared before the singing began
The singing began only after the priests left Jerusalem
medium.explanation: The trumpeters and singers first praised the LORD, and then the house was filled with a cloud.
medium.q: What connection does the passage show between the singing and the cloud?

answers: They made a united and coordinated sound
medium.explanation: The phrase shows that the trumpeters and singers acted together in unity.
medium.q: What does “as one” mean in the description of the trumpeters and singers?

answers: That united praise preceded the manifestation of God’s glory
That the priests did not participate
challenge.explanation: The passage presents united praise followed by the cloud filling the house.
challenge.q: What does the movement from one sound of praise to the cloud emphasize?

answers: The glory of the LORD filled the house of God
challenge.explanation: The verse explains that the priests could not minister because “the glory of the LORD had filled the house of God.”
challenge.q: Why could the priests not continue ministering?

answers: Thanksgiving focuses on God’s goodness and enduring mercy
Thanksgiving focuses on the number of priests
challenge.explanation: The words of praise emphasize the LORD’s goodness and His everlasting mercy.
challenge.q: What idea is emphasized by the repeated praise that the LORD is good and His mercy endures forever?
